title: EvaluationCase
description: A deterministic evaluation case. Pure evaluation only - never references a candidate skill or any optimization-loop concept.

schema_version.description: Bumped when the case schema makes a breaking change.

name.description: Lowercase-kebab slug used in filenames and bundle dirs.

skill.description: The skill this case targets, e.g. 'cesiumjs-camera'.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the case. Not consumed by the runner.

category.description: Primary scorecard category for this case.

critical.description: Whether a failure in this case should fail the scorecard gate.

prompt.description: Exact prompt issued to the implementation. Should specify the deterministic outcome so an LLM-free check can verify it.

preflight.description: Optional fixture state established before running the candidate. The runner is responsible for putting the scene into this state.

probe.description: Which scene-state values to capture before/after the candidate runs.

capture.description: Normalized evidence fields the capture layer must collect. Use wildcard collection paths such as imagery_layers[*].provider and concrete entity paths such as entities[marker].position_ecef.

actual_source.description: Optional provenance path for imported baseline-observed evidence.

checks.description: Deterministic assertions. All must pass for the case to pass.
